answer: A mechanism that actually bites: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because prism only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, basalt is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any nadir approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
